title: Seedance 2.0는 플랫폼마다 가격이 2~3배까지 달라질 수 있으니 결제 전에 여러 사이트의 동일 조건(모델/해상도/길이) 가격을 비교해…
content:
Seedance 2.0는 플랫폼마다 가격이 2~3배까지 달라질 수 있으니 결제 전에 여러 사이트의 동일 조건(모델/해상도/길이) 가격을 비교해 사용하라  
WaveSpeedAI에서 Seedance 2.0 Fast를 저렴하게 쓰려면 720p 5초($0.60)·15초($1.80), 1080p 5초($0.65)·15초($1.95) 기준으로 필요한 길이/해상도를 맞춰 생성하라  
WaveSpeedAI는 구독 없이 사용량만 결제 가능하니, 신규 $1 무료 크레딧으로 먼저 테스트한 뒤 결제하라  
Dreamina(공식)에서는 국가별 가격/사용 가능 여부와 일일 생성 제한이 있을 수 있으니 결제 전에 해당 조건을 확인하라  
OpenArt에서는 이미지/영상/오디오를 업로드해 Seedance 2.0 레퍼런스로 바로 사용해, 프롬프트만 쓰는 것보다 참고 자료 기반으로 결과를 통제하라  
Higgsfield에서 Seedance 무제한 상품이 보이면 결제 전에 기간과 대기열(큐) 조건을 반드시 확인하라  
fal ai를 사용할 때는 Seedance 2.0 Fast가 초당 $0.2419(10초≈$2.42)이므로, 영상 길이를 초 단위로 계산해 비용을 예측하고 API로 대량 생성 자동화를 구성하라  
Seedance 2.0 / Seedance 2.0 Fast / Seedance 2.0 Mini는 가격과 성능이 다르니, 사용할 모델을 명확히 구분해 비교하라  
처음부터 연간 결제하지 말고 무료 크레딧이나 최소 결제로 먼저 생성해 결과물을 비교한 뒤 플랜을 결정하라  
Seedance 비용은 해상도·길이·오디오·레퍼런스 사용 여부에 따라 달라지므로, 필요한 옵션만 켜서 비용을 최적화하라

---
Since the price of Seedance 2.0 can vary by 2 to 3 times depending on the platform, compare prices under the same conditions (model/resolution/length) across multiple sites before making a purchase.  
To use Seedance 2.0 Fast affordably on WaveSpeedAI, generate content by matching the required length/resolution based on 720p 5 seconds ($0.60)·15 seconds ($1.80), 1080p 5 seconds ($0.65)·15 seconds ($1.95).  
WaveSpeedAI allows you to pay only for usage without a subscription, so test with the new $1 free credit before purchasing.  
On Dreamina (official), there may be country-specific pricing/availability and daily generation limits, so check these conditions before purchasing.  
On OpenArt, you can upload images/videos/audio and use them directly as references for Seedance 2.0, allowing you to control the outcome based on reference materials rather than just using prompts.  
If you see an unlimited Seedance package on Higgsfield, be sure to check the duration and queue conditions before purchasing.  
When using fal ai, since Seedance 2.0 Fast costs $0.2419 per second (10 seconds ≈ $2.42), calculate the video length in seconds to predict costs and set up bulk generation automation via API.  
Seedance 2.0 / Seedance 2.0 Fast / Seedance 2.0 Mini differ in price and performance, so clearly distinguish and compare the models you intend to use.  
Do not commit to an annual payment from the start; instead, compare the results first using free credits or minimal payments before deciding on a plan.  
Seedance costs vary depending on resolution, length, audio, and reference usage, so optimize costs by enabling only the necessary options.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 1. WaveSpeedAI

Currently, it seems to offer the best value for money based on simple pricing.

For Seedance 2.0 Fast:

720p 5 seconds $0.60  
720p 15 seconds $1.80  
1080p 5 seconds $0.65  
1080p 15 seconds $1.95  

You only pay for what you create without a subscription, and new users can receive a $1 free credit.

[Thread 2] 2. Dreamina

The official service by ByteDance, creators of Seedance.

For Fast, an 8-second 720p video costs about $1.06, and the standard Seedance 2.0 is around $1.29.

As an official service, it has the advantage of quickly incorporating new models and features.

However, prices and availability may vary by country, and there may be daily generation limits, so check before purchasing.

[Thread 3] 3. OpenArt

If you're a beginner with AI video, this seems easy to use.

You can upload images, videos, and audio and use them directly as references for Seedance 2.0.

Low-cost annual plans start at about $7 per month, and free trial credits are also provided.

It's great for those who want to create videos by referencing various materials rather than just inputting prompts.

[Thread 4] 4. Higgsfield

If you want to do more than just create videos, such as:

- Camera direction
- Character consistency
- Advertising videos
- Cinematic videos

This is a good choice.

For Seedance 2.0 Fast, an 8-second 720p video is about $1.20, and the standard model is about $1.55.

Some accounts may see unlimited Seedance packages, but be sure to check the duration and queue conditions before purchasing.

[Thread 5] 5. fal ai

Recommended for developers or those looking to automate video creation.

Seedance 2.0 Fast costs $0.2419 per second, with a 10-second video costing about $2.42.

You pay only for what you use without a subscription, and it's easy to create bulk video generation automation using the API.

It's better suited for those who want to automate with Codex rather than just create a few videos.

[Thread 6] In summary

Creating a few cheaply  
→ WaveSpeedAI

Using the official service  
→ Dreamina

Easy creation for beginners  
→ OpenArt

Creating advertising and cinematic videos  
→ Higgsfield

Automating video generation  
→ fal ai

And some points to note:

Seedance 2.0  
Seedance 2.0 Fast  
Seedance 2.0 Mini

These three differ in price and performance.

Do not commit to an annual payment from the start; it's better to compare the results first using free credits or minimal payments.

Prices can continuously vary depending on resolution, length, audio, and reference usage.
